scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:levels && npm run verify:balance && npm run verify:platform && npm run e2e
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run build && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer npx cap sync ios
scripts.native:prepare: npm run assets:release && npm run cap:sync
scripts.google:aab: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
